content: The broken bowl repaired with gold is more radiant than the unbroken one.
author: Japanese Proverbs
explanation: In the classical Japanese craft of Kintsugi, shattered pottery is not concealed or thrown away; its fractures are mended with lacquer dusted in powdered gold. The fracture becomes the most illuminated part of the vessel. Our grief, failures, and wounds are not flaws to hide, but the golden seams of our character.
practicalInsight: Do not be ashamed of your past struggles or heartbreak. They are the golden seams through which empathy and wisdom enter your character.
reflectionPrompt: What fracture or painful break in your history has made you a more compassionate and resilient human being?
